text:
Lina (CTO): Heads-up: we're GA with Hosted API v2.1 as of 10:00 PT. This includes streaming responses, tool-calling hooks, and two tuned models (redwood-v2-medium, rwx-4k). Rolling out in phases across regions. Thanks to infra + eng-ml for the late nights :rocket:

DeployBot: started deployment: hosted/v2.1 -> eu-west-1, us-west-2, us-east-1 (phase 1). Canaries enabled.

Jordan (Product): Important: streaming & tool-calls are behind feature flags right now. Default behavior unchanged. Product docs updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/v2.1

Alex (Eng): Note for SDK owners: wire format adds an envelope when streaming (field: event_type). Client PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pulls?q=v2.1

OncallBot: New alert rule created: hosted-v2.1-tail-latency > 300ms for 5m. Pager goes to #eng-oncall. See runbook: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/hosted-v21

Ava (Solutions): For customers migrating from v2.0 -> v2.1, we recommend testing with the 'rwx-4k' model first, then switch to redwood-v2-medium for cost/latency tradeoffs. I have migration playbook in #customer-success.

Maya (Support): FYI support: quota adjustment for free tier — new limit is 30 rps and 50k burst tokens per hour. We already updated billing console banner.

Lina (CTO): Operational notes: if you run load tests tag them with 'hosted:v2.1' and include model name. We'll auto-collect traces. If you see unexpected OOMs on canaries, /cc @eng-runtime immediately.

Jordan (Product): Marketing draft ready. Hold external docs/email until 11:45 PT when we confirm metrics. Internal comms can go out now.

DeployBot: deployment complete for phase 1. Scheduling phase 2 in 2hrs.

Alex (Eng): Quick snippet for streaming client: ```js
const resp = await fetch(...);
for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) {
  // chunk.event_type: 'token' | 'tool_call' | 'done'
}
```

Maya (Support): If customers report tool-call schema mismatch, check client version and advise upgrade to >= 3.2.0.

Lina (CTO): Thanks. Callout to eng-infra & infra-ml: please monitor model cache hit rates — we expect caching to cut token compute by ~20% on average. Report anomalies in #eng-metrics.

Jordan (Product): TL;DR: v2.1 GA, feature-flagged streaming & tool-calls, new models, updated quotas for free tier, monitoring/alerts in place, marketing paused until metrics check. Post any issues here.
